The Angelus The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary. -- And she conceived by the Holy Spirit. Hail Mary… Behold, the handmaid of the Lord! -- Let it be done to me according to thy Word. Hail Mary… And the Word was made flesh. -- And dwelt among us. Hail Mary… Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God! -- That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ. Let us pray Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy grace into our hearts: that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ your Son, was made known by the message of an angel, may by his Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of his Resurrection, through t he same Christ our Lord. Amen. A Prayer for our Departed Loved Ones Heavenly Father, we remember our beloved family members, relatives, and friends who have gone before us. Thank You for the love, memories, and beautiful moments we shared with them. In Your infinite mercy, forgive their sins and welcome them into Your heavenly kingdom. May Your perpetual light shine upon them. Comfort those who mourn, strengthen our hope in the Resurrection, and remind us that Your love is stronger than death. Lord, grant eternal rest to departed loved ones and unite us one day in the joy of Your heavenly presence. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Louisburgh (Kilgeever)

Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th-13th December 2026 - Calling all young people aged 16–35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland. The Pontifical Irish College Lay Formation Programme offers a transformative year of academic, spiritual, pastoral, and human formation for young adults aged approximately 20-30. Participants live in community at the Pontifical Irish College while studying at one of Rome's pontifical universities and engaging with the rich spiritual and cultural life of the Eternal City. Applications are now open for our September 2027 intake. As places are limited, we encourage interested young adults to make contact as early as possible.
